ns2:section.sectionText: The course content and instruction will be delivered using the Compass course management system. There will NOT be a required meeting time but there will be weekly online discussions, lessons, and assignments. All specifics will be outlined on Compass. Behaviorial Sciences course. Topic: Children, Language and Communication Ability. SECOND EIGHT WEEK CLASS. The Department does not wait list. Class length is Oct. 18-Dec. 8, 2010.
